summary: Tested the new central NOG menu (/igss/nog), backend and frontend. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. Covers the global list (28 NOG from more than 1 unit, with unidad_nombre and fecha_asignacion, no _id), create with fecha_asignacion, duplicate number -> 400, validation 422/404, edit fecha/servicio, toggling is_active (changes estado and the nogs-activos availability), igss.admin create/edit/delete = 200, usuario = 403 on GET/POST/PUT, unauthenticated = 401/403. Frontend: the NOG item appears in the sidebar under IGSS for superadmin and igss.admin and is absent for usuario; usuario is redirected from /igss/nog to /pacientes. Table rows, totals cards, create, edit (Unidad disabled, fields prefilled), toggle (Inactivo/Activo badge), search by number and by service, unit filter and estado filter all work, and the totals follow the filters. Bug found and fixed: the page never mounted a sonner <Toaster />, so ALL toasts were invisible (validation errors 'El número de NOG es obligatorio' / 'La unidad es obligatoria', plus the create, edit and toggle success messages). Added Toaster as the other pages do; toasts now show. Validation does block creation (the dialog stays open and the count did not increase). Test NOGs (NOG-QA-*) deleted; total is back to 28.

minor.issue: fecha_asignacion is a free-form string with no YYYY-MM-DD format validation
The 'unidades' list includes inactive units (no is_active filter), so a NOG can be created in an inactive unit from the dialog

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: no <Toaster/> mounted, so no toast (error or success) was ever visible

issues: The 'Disp.' column shows the remaining cupos for inactive NOGs (e.g. 5) while the 'Disponibles' card counts 0 for inactive ones. Inconsistent; consider showing 0 or graying out the value for inactive NOGs
Fecha de asignación uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy in an en-US browser) instead of the shadcn Calendar used elsewhere
The Toaster is mounted per page instead of globally in App.js, a fragile pattern that caused this bug

action_items: Optional: validate the fecha_asignacion format (YYYY-MM-DD) in NogCreate/NogUpdate
Optional: exclude inactive units from the create-dialog unit selector
Optional: align the 'Disp.' column with the card for inactive NOGs
Consider mounting the sonner Toaster once globally in App.js
critical_code_review_comments: The unit filter and search run client-side over the full list (to_list(None)); fine at the current scale (28 NOG)
seed_data_creation: None persisted; NOG-QA-UI01, NOG-QA-UI02 and NOG-QA-PYT* were created and then deleted
context_for_next_testing_agent: The IGSS sidebar section is collapsible: click 'IGSS' before nav-gestion-nog becomes visible. Run the regression with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_gestion_nog.py (it cleans up after itself). The 'Administrador general' role (admin) has manage_igss_units=True in config/permissions.py; it was not tested with a real admin user because there are no credentials for one.
rca of the issue: Toasts not visible on /igss/nog: sonner's Toaster is not mounted globally; each page renders its own <Toaster/>. GestionNOG.js imported only `toast`, so toast() calls had no container. Fix: render <Toaster position='top-right' richColors /> inside the page.
